fields.label: Bench Path
fields.description: Absolute path to the bench that hosts company sites (e.g. /home/asofi/Benches/bench_asofi_v15).

fields.label: Default Site Domain Suffix
fields.description: Optional suffix appended to new site names (e.g. .rased.com).

fields.label: Apps To Install
fields.description: One app per line, installed on every new company site.

fields.label: Enable Public Trial Signup
fields.description: When on, the /asofisaas landing page lets visitors self-provision a trial site. Keep off until DNS + bench provisioning are ready on this host.

fields.label: Trial Plan
fields.description: Subscription plan assigned to self-service trial sites (e.g. trial).

fields.label: Trial Site URL Template
fields.description: How to build a trial site's reachable URL from its name. Production: https://{site}. Local dev (bench on :8000): http://{site}:8000.

fields.label: Mobile App Download URL
fields.description: Public link to download the Rased mobile app. Shown to new trial users on the success screen and in the welcome email.

fields.label: Sales WhatsApp (international format)
fields.description: e.g. 967771234567. Shown on the pricing page as a contact button for paid plans. Leave empty to hide it.

fields.label: Sales Email
fields.description: Fallback contact for paid-plan enquiries when no WhatsApp number is set.

fields.label: Enable Domain & SSL Automation
fields.description: Production only. On a server with nginx + certbot + passwordless sudo (bench setup sudoers <user>), provisioning regenerates nginx config, reloads it, and issues a Let's Encrypt certificate for each new site. Safely skipped elsewhere.
